dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent structures are visible on the posterior-lateral half: a large central 'O' with a thick, irregular low-intensity perimeter (approx. 8-12 pixels) and three smaller 'O' shapes near the posterior edge exhibiting jagged, high-contrast boundaries transitioning from black to light tan. An upper 'C' shape shows a sharp gradient on its dorsal edge with a softer transition ventrally.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid low-intensity (dark) pixels are densely concentrated in the anterior region, forming a nearly continuous zone along the dorsal ridge. High-intensity (light) pixel clusters are more sparsely distributed, primarily localized within the centers of macro-annuli and as discrete, non-gradient interstitial islands in the mid-ventral-lateral area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent 'O' structures in the posterior-lateral quadrant form a compact scalene triangle. When connected to the centroid of the primary anterior dark mass, these points define an elongated quadrilateral with a high aspect ratio along the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible anterior ventral appendage features four distinct, isolated low-intensity circular marks. The main dorsal low-intensity region terminates in a sharp, acute-angled geometric point at the posterior-most visible extremity.
